milestones.title: The Scoring King
milestones.description: Witnessed LeBron James surpass Kareem Abdul-Jabbar as the NBA all-time leading scorer (38 pts vs OKC).

milestones.title: Historic 50-PT Triple Double
milestones.description: Witnessed Russell Westbrook record his 42nd triple-double of the season with 50 PTS, 16 REB, 10 AST and a buzzer beater.

milestones.title: World Champions Crowned (Finals G7)
milestones.description: Attended NBA Finals Game 7 to witness championship history (OKC 103, IND 91).

milestones.title: NBA Finals Atmosphere (Finals G2)
milestones.description: Attended NBA Finals Game 2 (OKC 123, IND 107).

milestones.title: Vegas Lights (NBA Cup Semis)
milestones.description: Attended the In-Season Tournament / NBA Cup Semifinals double-header in Las Vegas.

milestones.title: Western Conference Finals
milestones.description: Attended Western Conference Finals Game 4 (SAS vs OKC).

milestones.title: The Wall at Intuit Dome
milestones.description: Attended multiple games at the revolutionary Intuit Dome in Inglewood (5 games attended).

milestones.title: Fifty-Piece Witness
milestones.description: Watched an NBA player explode for 50 or more points in a single live game.

milestones.title: Coast to Coast Hoops
milestones.description: Seen NBA basketball from the Atlantic coast (D.C., Philly, Brooklyn) to the Pacific (Bay Area, LA, Sacramento).

milestones.title: Thunder Faithful
milestones.description: Attended 35 games featuring the Oklahoma City Thunder across multiple eras.

milestones.title: Triple-Double Royalty
milestones.description: Seen 9 triple-doubles live in person by Russell Westbrook, Nikola Jokic, and James Harden.

milestones.title: Down to the Wire
milestones.description: Attended 8 games decided by 3 points or fewer, including 1-point heartstoppers.

milestones.title: Manny Being Manny (10 HRs)
milestones.description: Witnessed Manny Machado blast 10 home runs live in person across 32 games.

milestones.title: Roy Halladay Masterpiece
milestones.description: Witnessed Hall of Famer Roy Halladay throw a 9.0 IP Complete Game Shutout with 9 SO and 0 BB (Citizens Bank Park).

milestones.title: Historic Cathedral Duo
milestones.description: Attended games at Fenway Park (opened 1912) and Wrigley Field (opened 1914) — baseball's two oldest sacred grounds.

milestones.title: Petco Park Faithful (31 Games)
milestones.description: Attended 31 games at Petco Park in San Diego cheering on the Padres.

milestones.title: Yu Darvish Strikeout King
milestones.description: Watched Yu Darvish fan 30 batters across 8 electric starts in person.

milestones.title: Postseason Intensity (NLDS)
milestones.description: Attended National League Division Series postseason action (NLDS Game 3 vs Dodgers, Oct 2024).

milestones.title: Golden State Circuit
milestones.description: Visited all 5 California MLB ballparks: Dodger Stadium, Petco Park, Oracle Park, Angel Stadium, and Oakland Coliseum.

milestones.title: 27 of 30 MLB Franchises Seen
milestones.description: Seen 27 out of 30 Major League Baseball teams live in person (90.0% completion!).

milestones.title: Global Football Tour (4 Continents)
milestones.description: Attended football matches across North America, Europe, and Africa (Athens, Prague, Cape Town, Rome, Turin, California).

milestones.title: Rose Bowl Super-Clasico
milestones.description: Witnessed European royalty Real Madrid vs. Juventus at the historic Rose Bowl (93,702 fans, July 2022).

milestones.title: Serie A Double Header (Rome & Turin)
milestones.description: Attended Juventus vs Napoli at Allianz Stadium (Turin) and Roma vs Milan at Stadio Olimpico (Rome) in the same week.

milestones.title: European Championship Qualifier
milestones.description: Attended UEFA Euro Qualifiers live in Prague: Czech Republic vs. Bulgaria at Generali Arena.

milestones.title: USWNT 9-Goal Masterclass
milestones.description: Witnessed the US Women's National Team dismantle Paraguay 9-0 at FirstEnergy Stadium in Cleveland.

milestones.title: San Diego Wave Charter Fan
milestones.description: Attended 19 San Diego Wave FC matches at Torero Stadium and Snapdragon Stadium cheering on Alex Morgan & Co.

milestones.title: South African PSL Under Table Mountain
milestones.description: Attended Cape Town City vs. Stellenbosch at Athlone Stadium in Cape Town, South Africa.
